extra.summary: Chassis plate + a 120 mm OD aluminium bayonet receptacle stay on the harness; S1 base, AK70 stage, crown and keel detach as one ~3 kg module with a 4-pin 23 deg twist-lock, spring-plunger + safety slide latch and a blind-mate connector (all PLACEHOLDER). Donning without the arm; hand swaps; field service.
extra.twist_direction: Module rotates -23 deg about +x (dock axis, +x rearward) to lock, i.e. the sense gravity drives it for a lateral (+y) arm weight (M_x = -W*y). Gravity roll therefore drives pins INTO the closed slot end; unlocking needs +23 deg against gravity PLUS retracting the plunger and the safety slide. Left arm is the mirror (+23). S1 torque (about z) and S2 pitch (about y) are bending moments on the spigot: reacted as axial pin/ramp loads (couple across the 4 pins, face r~50 mm), NOT as twist. Only S2 torque when S1 has swung the S2 axis onto x, and roll gravity, load the twist lock.

mass_vs_REF.note: same proxy basis; REF = plate 278.8 + base block 125.2 + crown 67.7 + keel 65.7 + spaulder 28.2

contract_changes: S1 base 4 x M5 on the plate (y +-62, z -94/-68) REPLACED by a D84 plate bore + 6 x M5 on PCD 104 holding the dock ring (plate loses 4 tapped holes)
S1 base block shortened 80 -> 54 mm (x -54..0) and bolted (6 x M5 PLACEHOLDER) to the dock-side adapter flange instead of the plate
keel feet (2 x M4 csk through the plate) deleted; keel hem now bolts to the crown only and travels with the module
crown rear edge moves from x -84 to -62 (ring occupies x -80..-62)
new electrical interface: blind-mate connector (S1 bundle, CAN, 12 V, plus 24 V) across the dock; AK70 cable port in the keel (PLACEHOLDER) must route to the plug
spaulder rear feet (2 x M3 into plate top edge, x -84) and F1/F4 seats UNCHANGED; ring (x>-80) clears them
dock axis is x at z -81: ring top reaches z -21 above the plate top (-54): re-run skin/clasp/neck ROM for the armour and head keep-out
assembly order (ASSEMBLY.md section B) changes: module assembled and tested off-body
decision_conflicts: none of the standing decisions broken (no backplate/hip belt, joints, stops, 5 deg rule); load path unchanged in kind; adds ~mass to the top pad (binding gate 14.28 of 14.7 kPa): must be checked
I1 shoulder geometry is LOCKED: this reopens it (new interface contract)

loads.basis: Mx=8.3(S2 cap onto x at S1 swing)+W_arm*0.25+W_mod*0.02; Mb=hypot(S1 cap 8.3, S2 8.3+W_mod*0.055+W_arm*0.10)

pin.formula: F_ax=Mb*x/sum(x^2), x=r cos45, r=46.5 mm, 4 pins; F_t=Mx/(4 r); sigma=F*e/(pi d^3/32), e=5 mm; bearing=F/(d*9 mm)

release.formula: T=F_shear*0.052 m, F_shear=tau*pi d^2/4; friction/preload not counted

preload.face_lift_check: per-pin axial 'Fpin_ax' must be < preload per pin else the flange face lifts; need >= 110 N/pin (>= 440 N total) from the cam ramp + wave spring; ramp 3 deg, mu 0.15: lock torque ~ F*r*tan(3deg+8.5deg)=4.2 N.m
preload.tilt_if_unpreloaded: spigot radial clearance 0.1 / length 18 -> 0.64 deg -> 6.4 mm at the tip; hence a 5 deg tapered spigot seat or preloaded flange face is mandatory

extra.printability: ring and adapter spigot are turned 6061 (not printed); pins/latch bought; crown/keel PA-CF as before; block PETG-CF printed with a flat flange face down. All parts < 256 mm.
donning: 1 harness + plate + ring on the body, module off (arm-less, ~2.6 kg lighter on the shoulders)
2 line the module's red arrows at the entry slots, push -x until the flange seats
3 twist -23 deg (right arm) until the plunger snaps and the red indicator pops
4 push the safety slide; connector mates blind during the push
5 doffing: slide, pull plunger, +23 deg, pull; dead-man must trip when the connector unmates
pros: don/doff the harness without the 3 kg arm
hand rev B/C swap and arm service off body
module can be bench-tested and charged separately
keel feet and 4 M5 bolts go away
cons: more mass and parts: see mass delta
backlash / tilt error at P unless preloaded (tip error up to 6 mm uncorrected)
an unlatch failure drops 3 kg on the wearer: needs a double-action latch
connector adds a failure point in the E-stop / dead-man chain
ring sticks out 33 mm above the plate top: new ROM check
risks: preload loss under 13 N.m bending lifts the flange face
wave-spring/cam creep in the printed-free Al parts is minor; latch wear
cable bundle through the D66 spigot is tight with the 8.2 mm S1 bundle
